name: chief-of-staff-demo
description: Local web app that hosts Found42's meeting and content workflows as tabs in one app.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && npm run build --workspace @chief-of-staff-demo/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared apps/server && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p tests --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run knip && npm test
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @chief-of-staff-demo/shared && tsx watch apps/server/src/main.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e --workspace @chief-of-staff-demo/tests
